description: Golden-ratio fractal grid drawn from a drifting origin; cells fill as right-triangle wedges, near-monochrome with film-grain overlay
notable: grid-line spacing expands by the golden ratio outward from the origin, which lerps between random targets

description: Golden-ratio fractal grid with a fixed lattice but drifting fill origin; triangle-wedge cells over near-white with grain
notable: decouples the static grid origin from the moving cell origin so only the filled wedges migrate

description: Golden-ratio fractal grid whose origin scrolls diagonally and wraps around the frame; triangle-wedge cells, film grain
notable: origin uses modulo wrapping so the densest grid region cycles endlessly across the canvas

description: Static golden-ratio fractal grid; darkest palette color fills triangle-wedge cells, lightest as ground, low-contrast strokes
notable: roles assigned by lightness/contrast: brightest color to ground, darkest to fill, lowest-contrast to lines

description: Static golden-ratio fractal grid of triangle-wedge cells; brightest palette color as ground, darkest as fill
notable: named 'mouse' but renders a single static frame with no pointer interaction wired up

description: Scattered steampunk parts — gears, pipes, circuit traces, hex bolts — randomly placed and re-rolled each frame on near-black
notable: components regenerate every frame, so the assembly flickers rather than animating smoothly

description: Meshing gear train: collision-free placement, gears counter-rotate at radius-derived ratios, thin lines mark engaged pairs
notable: connected gears set speed to -parentSpeed * radiusRatio, emulating real gear coupling

description: Gears linked by drive belts drawn as tangent lines wrapping each wheel; coupled gears share rotation, dark greyscale
notable: belts built from two tangent segments plus arcs hugging each pulley

description: Gear train grown outward from a center wheel into meshing positions, some coupled by belts, at radius-based gear ratios
notable: each new gear is seeded at parent.radius+new.radius distance so wheels touch and mesh

description: Gears coupled by bicycle-style chains; chain path from tangent geometry, link dots animate around the loop, dark greyscale
notable: chain links travel along the computed path via a playhead-driven offset

description: Five hard-edge columns of binary fill/hole bands, sheared by computed angles and clipped, over two red triangles on cream
notable: column bands are rotated by angles derived from the two triangles' edge slopes

description: Gravura column composition of binary fill/hole bands, sheared and clipped, recolored from a pro-color-harmonies palette
notable: triangles split into four independently colored halves

description: Gravura five-column band composition with a pro-color-harmonies palette; columns grouped into color triads, sheared and clipped
notable: columns grouped 0-1 / 2-3 / 4 sharing one palette color each

description: Gravura column composition in a pro-color palette, triangles split and shaded, finished with Atkinson dithering
notable: Atkinson dither at 0.75 scale gives the flat shapes a printed/engraved grain

description: Gravura columns animated through RYB color cubes; fill bands cycle hue and lightness over the loop, sheared clip layout
notable: colors sampled from historical RYB color-wheel gamuts (itten, goethe, munsell, ...)

description: Gravura columns as sliding venetian blinds — each band splits and offsets in a staggered reveal — colored via RYB cubes
notable: per-column phase offset makes the blinds ripple across the piece

description: Circle-packing 'grey goo' floods the canvas around GENUARY lettering left as negative space; re-packs every frame
notable: text mask rasterized to an offscreen canvas and sampled per-pixel for packing collision

description: Circle-packing fills the canvas around GENUARY lettering held as negative space; single static packing on near-black
notable: static single-pack sibling of the animated grey-goo lettering piece

description: Circle packing fills a self-portrait silhouette (varun.svg) with white discs on near-black; re-packs each frame
notable: silhouette sampled from an SVG portrait; discs fill the figure rather than the ground

description: Circle packing fills a Skeletor silhouette loaded from SVG with white discs on near-black; re-packs each frame
notable: same pack-into-silhouette method aimed at a pop-culture character mask

description: Cellular-automaton growth from one seed cell on a 10px grid; active cells take a palette color that shifts over the loop
notable: custom growth rule: an empty cell with exactly one active neighbor turns on

description: A nalee space-filling walker fills each polygon-domain grid cell, then backtracks to hop into adjacent cells until all are packed
notable: walker is constrained to one domain cell at a time and backtracks its path to find a legal transition into an unvisited neighbor

description: 20x20 grid of random blue blocks overlaid with clusters of unicode box and triangle glyphs in black and white
notable: slow ~0.33fps refresh reshuffles the entire field each frame

description: 20x20 grid of random blue blocks with diagonal 'stair' runs and small checkerboard clusters stamped on top
notable: diagonal stair runs and checkerboard stamps are overlaid on the random block field
